September 25 2625
ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the DS-3, Downtown Service District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 6-E in the area bounded by:

a line 200 feet north of and parallel to East 23 Street; the alley next east of and parallel
to South Wabash Ave.; a line 140 feet north of and parallel to East 23" Street; and South
Wabash Ave.

to those of a DX-3, Downtown Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 2241 South Wabash Ave.
